title: Up Keep Round 5: White Base Follow-Ups, Re-Asks, Photo Onboarding, Visit Log, Home Record, Ask Anything, Reminders, Tech App, Email And Receipts
brands: Up Keep / Smart Upkeep: home maintenance membership app (https://webermanapps.github.io/smart-upkeep/)
Base: white, #0A0A0A ink, square black buttons, Khand/Hind; 2-3 small pops (terracotta = act, lagoon = info, jungle = done, saffron = due soon); no neon, no pastel, not all-beige
builds_on: upkeep-4 results (45/50; white won; top tags lively, neighbor, big, visual, readable, easy, simple, guided; avoided concierge, bold, thorough, crew, calm, clean; skipped 17, 26, 27, 49, 50 re-asked here; NEITHERs 36 tech detail and 47 get third directions); upkeep-3 results (32/50; top tags system, clear, warm, simple, lively; notes: drop score screens, show uniforms on people); upkeep-1 top tags clear, system, warm, lively, multi-accent; upkeep-2 top tags clear, system, visual, guided, easy (no upkeep results files in results/)
